name: gram.js
description: Gram.js is the Graphical Editing Framework. With this framework you can easily build your own WYSIWYG graphical editor such as flow-chart, prototype tool, ui builder and modeling tool. Gram keeps an eye on your model, major purpose of this framework is editing your model graphically. To support this effectively, Gram is composed of MVC. [Gram View](#gram-view) takes charge for View and [Gram Editor](#gram-editor) is for Controller. [Gram Editor](#gram-editor) is now in developing.
